name: Caltrain Dollar Fares for Youth
description: $1 One-Way, $2 Day Pass, $24 Monthly Pass for youth 18 and under
fullDescription: Caltrain is a commuter rail line running 77 miles along the San Francisco Peninsula, connecting San Francisco to San Jose and Gilroy. The Dollar Fares program makes train travel extremely affordable for young riders.
whatTheyOffer:
- $1 One-Way fare for youth 18 and under (all zones)
- $2 Day Pass for unlimited rides in one day
- $24 Monthly Pass (all zones)
- No income requirements—available to all youth
howToGetIt:
1. Get a free Youth Clipper card (apply online at clippercard.com)
2. The $1 one-way fare works with all payment methods; buy Day Passes on Caltrain Mobile or at ticket machines
3. Tap Clipper card or show your ticket when boarding
4. One child age 4 and under rides free with each paying adult
keywords: Caltrain, youth, dollar fare, train, Peninsula, San Francisco, San Jose, Gilroy, Clipper, commuter rail, kids
